name: graph_list_runs
title: graph.list_runs
description: Every mining run this server has ever seen, most recent first, each with its resume state. Backs /list-runs. A user with no prior context has no repo, no runId, and no starting point except 'what have I mined so far' — nothing else answers that without already knowing what to ask for.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.
